title: Roof Leak Sensor Repeat Damp Spots
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roofleak:event
| stats count(eval(wet=true)) as wet_events count as samples by location_name
| sort 0 - wet_events
description: Ranks locationss by roof leak damp spots.
value: A repeat location list helps you focus inspection and repair effort on the spots proving they are not one-off events.
implementation: Send roof leak damp spots events to `index=personal` and keep `location_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of roof leak damp spots by locations.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which locationss stand out most for roof leak damp spots.
